children: As part of MilDef’s continued integration of roda computer GmbH and Westek Technology Ltd., both companies now formally adopt the MilDef name, defining MilDefs position as a leading, European provider of tactical IT.

Effective today, roda computer GmbH and Westek Technology Ltd. has been rebranded to MilDef GmbH and MilDef UK Limited. This marks the next step in the integration of the two companies following MilDef’s acquisition of roda Group in 2025. By aligning under one brand, MilDef strengthens its position as a leading provider of tactical IT and digitalization solutions for defence.

“The name change reflects MilDef’s long-term strategy of fully integrating roda and Westek into the MilDef Group. Bringing our businesses together under one brand creates a stronger and more unified platform for serving customers while maintaining the expertise, products and relationships that have made roda and Westek trusted partners for many years
,” says Daniel Ljunggren, President and CEO MilDef Group.
While the names are changing, the products, teams, expertise and customer relationships remain the same.
The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out below, at 09:00 CEST on September, 23, 2026.
Olof Engvall, Head of IR & Communications

MilDef provides rugged IT solutions, systems integration and services for the defense industry. Our systems are proven in real conditions and built to stand firm in every detail. We safeguard more than equipment, we safeguard the mission itself. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.
